answer: Mechanism: vouched stake. Every agent locks a slashable bond and gains weight only from peers who vouch for its unique identity; cloned keys add zero weight. To sway a vote an attacker must post a fresh bond and secure a separate vouch for every fake self, like seeding a second garden, floating saffron through its own inlet, and paying a new guarantor each time. Cost grows linearly with the number of Sybils, and any exposed duplicate forfeits its bond.
